protocol.input: Synthetic calibrated keypoints with supplied identities. No RGB detection, decode or upload is timed.
protocol.calibration: Known synthetic K except estimated-focal cases: input focal replaced by 0.8*width; shared focal searched from images.
protocol.truth: Only the evaluator reads true poses, points and source labels. No ground-truth depth/pose enters reconstruction.
protocol.masks: Only screen-fixed-masked uses explicitly ground-truth-sourced feature masks.
protocol.alignment: One fixed seed pose/baseline gauge per whole connected map, never per-frame alignment.
protocol.timing: One warmup per version then alternating paired runs, reconstruction only; includes CPU geometry, tracking and BA. Other checks may run concurrently: timings are diagnostic, not acceleration evidence.
